entry.title: Verlet Integration Softbody Physics — Jelly, Cloth, and Rope
entry.summary: Build a softbody physics engine using Verlet integration and distance constraints, simulating jelly cubes, cloth sheets, and swinging ropes in real time.

entry.title: Impossible Geometry — Shader Tricks That Lie About Depth
entry.summary: Render Penrose triangles, Escher staircases, and impossible objects using fragment shaders that manipulate depth to create geometries that cannot exist in 3D.

entry.title: Audio Spectrogram Terrain — Fly Through Sound
entry.summary: Transform audio spectrograms into 3D terrain and fly through the landscape of sound, where frequency is width, time is depth, and amplitude is height.

entry.title: Boids on Curved Manifolds — Flocking on a Torus
entry.summary: Simulate Reynolds' flocking algorithm on curved surfaces where topology wraps, twists, and changes the meaning of "nearby" — boids on a torus, sphere, and Klein bottle.

entry.title: Fourier Ocean Waves — Tessendorf's FFT Water Simulation
entry.summary: Implement Jerry Tessendorf's FFT-based ocean simulation, the same technique used in film VFX at Pixar and Weta, running in real time with Three.js.

entry.title: Wave Function Collapse — Constraint Propagation Visualized
entry.summary: Visualize the Wave Function Collapse algorithm step by step, watching entropy collapse and constraints propagate to generate coherent tile patterns from local rules.

entry.title: LLM-Guided Evolutionary Art — Language as Fitness Function
entry.summary: Evolve visual art using genetic algorithms where a local LLM judges fitness, replacing mathematical objectives with natural language like "more crystalline" or "more ominous."

entry.title: Music From Geometry — Modal Analysis and Shape Acoustics
entry.summary: Synthesize sound from 3D shapes by computing their resonant frequencies, turning geometry into musical instruments using modal analysis.

entry.title: Non-Euclidean Rendering — Curved Space in the Browser
entry.summary: Ray march through hyperbolic and spherical geometries where parallel lines diverge, rooms are bigger on the inside, and straight lines curve.

entry.title: Physarum Simulation — Slime Mold Intelligence on the GPU
entry.summary: Simulate Physarum polycephalum's emergent network behavior using GPU ping-pong framebuffers, where 40,000 simple agents create stunning organic transport networks.

entry.title: Flow Fields — Curl Noise and Particle Advection
entry.summary: Build flow field visualizations using curl noise for divergence-free vector fields, with thousands of advected particles in Three.js.

entry.title: Strange Attractors — Visualizing Chaotic Systems
entry.summary: Simulate and render strange attractors (Lorenz, Rössler, Aizawa) as particle traces in 3D, exploring deterministic chaos and sensitive dependence.

entry.title: Cellular Automata — Emergent Complexity from Simple Rules
entry.summary: Explore cellular automata from Conway's Game of Life to 3D visualization, showing how simple local rules produce complex emergent behavior.

entry.title: Voronoi Diagrams — Cell-Based Procedural Textures
entry.summary: Generate Voronoi patterns on the GPU using distance fields, with applications to procedural textures, organic patterns, and terrain generation.

entry.title: L-Systems — Procedural Plants from String Rewriting
entry.summary: Generate procedural trees and plants using Lindenmayer systems, turtle interpretation, and 3D branching rules with interactive Three.js rendering.

entry.title: Reaction-Diffusion — Turing Patterns on the GPU
entry.summary: Simulate the Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion model using GPU ping-pong framebuffers to generate Turing patterns in real time.

entry.title: Mandelbulb — 3D Fractals via Ray Marching
entry.summary: Render the Mandelbulb fractal in real time using ray marching, triplex algebra, and distance estimation, with an interactive GLSL viewer.

entry.title: Marching Cubes — Isosurface Extraction from Scalar Fields
entry.summary: Extract meshes from scalar fields using marching cubes, with lookup tables, normal estimation, and an interactive metaball demo.

entry.title: Attention Visualization in Transformers
entry.summary: Extract and visualize self-attention patterns from transformer models, showing what different heads learn with interactive heatmaps.

entry.title: Embedding Spaces in 3D
entry.summary: Visualize high-dimensional embeddings using PCA, t-SNE, and UMAP, with an interactive 3D scatter plot of word clusters.
